# has site

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSite`](gmeow-hasSite.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSite>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an organization to a location it occupies or operates from — a headquarters, branch, or registered office. Reuses the places module's [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md). Non-functional: an organization may have several sites, and competing standpoint-indexed location claims coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) -> [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to relate an organization to a [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) it operates from — a headquarters, branch, or registered office — reusing the places-module location rather than minting an organization-local place.

### Avoid when

- Avoid carrying the site's purpose here (that is [`gmeow:siteType`](gmeow-siteType.md) on the location) and avoid a flat address literal — point at a structured [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md); competing location claims coexist via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:hasSite`](gmeow-hasSite.md) triple per site referencing a [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md), and tag each location's role with [`gmeow:siteType`](gmeow-siteType.md); carry sensitive precise coordinates with [`gmeow:coarsenTo`](gmeow-coarsenTo.md) for public projection.

### Examples

- ex:acme [`gmeow:hasSite`](gmeow-hasSite.md) ex:torontoOffice.
